summary: The documented analytical and batch-testing CRL remains the principal concern. Pharming reports an accepted resubmission addressing those requests, but FDA resolution is unconfirmed; no efficacy results are supplied for the current pediatric indication.
pivotalQuestion: Does the revised analytical-method and batch-testing package resolve the prior CRL deficiencies for children aged 4–11 weighing at least 27 kg?

factors.rationale: The registry describes a single-group phase 3 study with estimated enrollment of 15. No efficacy results supporting the current age-and-weight indication are supplied.
The supplied packet contains no pediatric safety results.

The prior CRL involved analytical-method and batch-testing requests. Pharming reports submitting a responsive package after a Type A meeting, but resubmission acceptance does not establish FDA resolution.
Pharming reports FDA acceptance of the resubmission for ages 4–11 weighing at least 27 kg. Lower-weight children require a separate filing; acceptance is procedural progress, not approval.
